vocabulary.grain_size: Perceived scale of individual sand particles.
vocabulary.density: Concentration of grains in an area.
vocabulary.direction: Visual flow or movement of grains.
vocabulary.accumulation: Where grains gather into mass or shadow.
vocabulary.dispersion: How grains spread and thin into space.
vocabulary.dissolve: Transition from defined form into loose grains.
vocabulary.negative_space: Untouched paper used as an active compositional element.
vocabulary.motion: Time-based behavior of sand and line.
vocabulary.interaction: User-driven behavior such as scroll, cursor wind or touch.
